text:
Mina: Quick sync  we need a lightweight playbook for the SI + HW bundle launch with LangChain gateway partners. Can we agree on owners and an embargoed announcement timeline? :calendar:

Priya: +1. Who's owning the marketplace listing and who's doing the joint PR draft? I can take the marketplace assets if someone drafts copy.

Sam: I'll own the joint PR draft and coordinate with marketing. Timeline idea: announce partner pilot on Apr 14, public launch Apr 28. Is that tight for HW SKU approvals?

Carlos: For the HW partner (NPI vendor), certification window is 3w for images and 2w for packaging. Apr 28 launch requires certification artifacts by Apr 7. We don't have those yet.

Elise: Technical gating: gateway adapter needs a small change to support our auth header passthrough. ETA for code + tests: 5 business days if prioritized. Also need a smoke test matrix for orchestration flows.

Mina: OK  action items:
- Carlos: push vendor for certification artifacts by Mar 31
- Elise: PR for auth passthrough by Mar 28
- Priya: marketplace assets + BOM by Apr 1
- Sam: PR draft by Apr 4, coordinate with legal for embargo

Priya: I'll assemble assets. What should go in the marketplace listing? Short cert badge, supported SKUs, minimum infra, and a one-liner about orchestration compatibility.

Elise: Add a small snippet for the adapter README showing how to route requests to Redwood Dedicated and fallback to hosted:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: /gen
    route: dedicated:pool-1
    fallback: hosted:small-lr
```

Carlos: Also require a hardware SKU table. I'll get that from the partner. Note: partner wants co-branding guidelines  need legal review.

Sam: I'll draft the PR. Can we lock the embargo to Apr 12 (internal) with public Apr 28? That gives partners two weeks to review copy. Legal ok?

Mina: Sounds good. Legal review deadline Apr 8. Sam, loop in legal on the draft early.

Priya: Marketplace checklist draft in short form:
- [ ] Listing copy
- [ ] Cert badge + artifacts
- [ ] Images and co-branding
- [ ] BOM/SKUs
- [ ] Pricing tier notes
- [ ] Onboarding doc link

Priya: I'll post the checklist in the partnership drive and tag owners.

Elise: For the orchestration smoke tests, I created a minimal matrix. Will add to the repo under /tests/si-hw-bundle. Need a tiny CI job to run it on each push. @DeployBot can you create a job stub?

DeployBot: CI job created: si-hw-bundle-smoke (runs on PRs to main). CI link: https://ci.internal/reports/si-hw-bundle

Carlos: Partner asked for a joint announcement deck  do we have a template? Marketing?

Sam: I'll use the partner deck template and fill in technical slides. Mina  can you get partner logos + contact for the deck by Mar 29?

Mina: On it. I'll also set up a short partner review window Apr 5	67. If we don't get sign-off, we delay the public launch.

Priya: One more ask: SI enablement session  30 min live demo for partner SIs the week after launch. Who demos infra and orchestration?

Elise: I'll do the orchestration demo, Carlos can speak to HW setup. Sam can handle the announcement/q&a.

Mina: Nice. Summary of deadlines:
- Mar 28: Elise PR (auth)
- Mar 29: partner logos + contacts
- Mar 31: cert artifacts pushed
- Apr 1: marketplace assets ready
- Apr 4: PR draft with marketing
- Apr 5	67: partner review
- Apr 7: legal sign-off target
- Apr 12: internal embargo lock
- Apr 14: pilot announcement (partner-only)
- Apr 28: public launch

Carlos: I'll escalate certification timeline with partner today.

Sam: I'll start the PR draft and ping legal.

Priya: Checklist and drive link posted: https://drive.internal/partnerships/si-hw-bundle

Mina: Thanks team. Can we reconvene next Tuesday for a quick handoff? 15 min.

Elise: Works for me.

Carlos: +1.

Sam: +1.

DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: next sync Tue 09:30.
